name: Project File Infection
summary: Adversaries may attempt to infect project files with malicious code. These project files may consist of objects, program organization units, variables such as tags, documentation, and other configurations needed for PLC programs to function. Using built in functions of the engineering software, adversaries may be able to download an infected program to a PLC in the operating environment enabling further Execution and Persistence techniques.…

analytics.name: Analytic 1898
analytics.guidance: Configured Windows object-access monitoring identifies a write to an Industrial Control System (ICS) engineering project file by a process that is not the recognized vendor engineering software, or by the vendor engineering software immediately after loading a project file from an untrusted source. Documented mechanism in Havex (trojanized vendor software/installers distributed via compromised vendor websites). analytics.name: Analytic 2116
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to Industrial Control System (ICS) project file paths on a Linux engineering station from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with the ICS engineering tool, or from the tool after loading a file from a removable media or network path not in the approved software distribution list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Security
log_sources.channel: Windows Security Event ID 4663 (requires Object Access auditing/SACL): engineering process reads/opens project file from unapproved repository/removable-media/network-share path

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
log_sources.channel: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational Event ID 11 FileCreate/overwrite or Event ID 2 FileCreateTime, as applicable: Engineering tool process opens project file from path not in approved project repository (removable media, email attachment cache, untrusted network share)

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL+PATH
log_sources.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL+PATH records: write to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) project file path by uid not in authorized engineering User Identifiers (UIDs) or from path not in approved project sources
